title: Parse canonical v1 match intents without authority overrides
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export MatchIntentV1, MatchIntentParseResultV1 and parseMatchIntentV1(input:unknown) from protocol/src/match-intents-v1.ts. Freeze exact own-field variants: {type:"start-match",expectedRevision}; {type:"crew-vote",candidateId,expectedRevision}; {type:"operation-choice",optionId,expectedRevision}; {type:"power-target",powerId,targetId,expectedRevision}; {type:"containment-vote",candidateId,expectedRevision}; {type:"request-advance",expectedRevision}. candidateId/targetId use canonical player IDs; optionId is a semantic incident Route/Gate key, never a file path. powerId is one of track.repair.safeguard, track.repair.audit_window, track.sabotage.grid_failure, track.sabotage.signal_sever, track.sabotage.blackout_order. request-advance is for host automation and grants no ability to skip a deadline. Require safe revisions and strict own data fields; return fresh allowlisted values or fixed invalid_match_intent/schema-only paths. Reject actor, role, seed, outcome, deadline, force or gameplay-result overrides. Keep v0 parseCommand unchanged and do not import engine into protocol.
acceptance: Direct single-candidate votes and own Route/Gate choices are represented; no nominate-two or boolean approval variants enter v1.
All six exact variants have canonical-value, unknown-field, accessor, symbol, malformed-object and safe-error tests.
Parsing grants no membership/phase/actor authority; service must map validated intent to trusted domain context.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
